plan: Keep the authored recipe immutable: print_original returns authored_text byte-for-byte; adapt constructs all-new dicts/lists and never writes into recipe, request, or catalog.
Scale exactly with Fraction: compute scale = target_yield / recipe yield once and multiply every ingredient quantity (including component and substitution-added ingredients) by it.

Resolve exclusions per ingredient with a chained-substitution loop: while the current name is excluded, select the catalog choice with the lowest (priority, catalog-index) key, apply its result, and track visited names to detect cycles; a reintroduced exclusion chains onward with a warning.

Applying a choice updates every dependent field in one place: quantity via quantity_factor, unit (with a warning), preparation text, ordered wording-change pairs, equipment additions/removals against a working equipment set, an optional yield_factor (compensated at the end so the result stays at target yield), and additional ingredients pushed onto a work queue that re-enters the same exclusion/substitution pipeline.

Accumulate impossibility instead of failing fast: collect 'no substitution for NAME', 'substitution cycle involving NAME', and one 'equipment NAME unavailable' per missing item into a set, and only after all ingredients and the final equipment set are processed decide possible/impossible, returning sorted reasons and null recipe on failure.

Defer instruction rewriting: wording-change pairs accumulate in choice order and are applied to main and component instruction strings only when adaptation is known to be possible, yielding the final observable wording.
Emit choices as the ordered list of applied catalog IDs and warnings as a sorted, de-duplicated list in both the possible and impossible outcomes.
mechanisms: verbatim authored-text preservation (print_original returns the stored string unchanged)
pure-function adaptation via fresh-structure construction (no input mutation)
deterministic choice selection by (priority, catalog index) key
chained substitution loop with visited-name cycle detection
single _apply_result step keeping quantity, unit, preparation, wording, equipment, and yield consistent per choice
work queue subjecting substitution-introduced ingredients to the same exclusion and catalog rules
exhaustive reason accumulation (set of all independent failure reasons, sorted on output)
post-substitution equipment containment check against available_equipment
deferred ordered wording rewrites applied to instruction strings at the end
